headline: The pitching market broke open in one day: Peralta to Baltimore, Taira to Toronto, Bubic to Cleveland, and the Cubs added Sato to Rogers. King is the best arm left with a week to the lockout.

news.title: Orioles sign Freddy Peralta: five years, $125 million
news.note: The biggest deal ever for an Orioles pitcher, with a $10M signing bonus. The ALCS MVP replaces Trevor Rogers, who left for the Cubs.

news.title: Blue Jays land Kaima Taira: five years, $80 million
news.note: NPB's ERA leader (1.36) gets an opt-out after year three. Toronto's first big move after missing on Skubal.

news.title: Cubs agree with Teruaki Sato: six years, $120 million
news.note: The 2026 Central League Triple Crown winner heads to a corner outfield spot. It's $240M for the Cubs in about 12 hours, counting Rogers.

news.title: Kris Bubic takes one year, $17.5 million from Cleveland
news.note: A pillow deal after an elbow-shortened 2026. It sets the price for one-year bounce-back starters.

news.title: Brandon Lowe draws six suitors; King now the top arm left
news.note: Morosi names the Yankees, Orioles, Blue Jays, Rays, Padres and Phillies on Lowe after his 35-homer year. Michael King is now likely the best starter on the market.
